extraction.text:
Priyanka Roy Priyankaroyp324@gmail.com | +91 9830642938

7+ years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 4+ years in Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata Management, Data Lineage, and Critical Data Elements (CDEs). Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain end-to-end data traceability.

Skills

Data Governance: Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Business Glossary, Data Catalog, Critical Data Elements (CDE), Data Profiling, Data Quality Tools: Collibra, JIRA, SQL, Power BI, Advance Excel, TLM, GENEVA, Bloomberg

• Methodologies: Agile (Sprint Planning, Scrum, Issue Tracking)

State Street

Jan 2023-Sep2025

Emerging Lead

Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives using Collibra Data Governance, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance of critical data assets across the enterprise domain and community structures.

Led the Data Attestation process by coordinating with Application Owners to validate inflows, outflows, Non-ADS gaps, and control mechanisms, and drove remediation of incorrect or missing data flows through Collibra workflows, glossary management, domain alignment, community collaboration, and metadata governance.

Performed data profiling, root cause analysis, and Data Quality (DQ) assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs) using SQL queries to identify data anomalies and ensure data integrity.

Collaborated with application teams to request and implement metadata changes in Collibra and internal systems, maintaining accurate and up-to-date metadata repositories, business glossary terms, domain ownership, community participation, and asset relationships.

Drove Data Harmonization initiatives to align data elements, data flows, and application architecture with product standards, enterprise data governance policies, domain definitions, and community best practices.

Analyzed and published QA Breaks and Non-ADS reports using SQL, created and tracked JIRA tickets, and coordinated with stakeholders to remediate identified issues across domains and communities.

Onboarded new Critical Data Elements (CDEs) into the application architecture and established lineage relationships using Collibra asset functions, including asset creation, classification, domain assignment, community mapping, and relationship management.

Configured and managed Collibra workflows, customized data capture templates, and leveraged JIRA while following Agile methodologies, including Sprint Planning, Product Backlog Grooming, and Sprint Backlog Management.

Analyzed business requirements and translated them into high-level and low-level use cases, activity diagrams, and functional specifications to support data governance, metadata management, domain modeling, and community engagement initiatives.

Utilized SQL for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities to support data quality assessments and lineage verification.

Worked closely with Data Stewards, Application Owners, and cross-functional teams to enhance metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, domain governance, and community collaboration capabilities using Collibra.

Northern Trust

May 2022 -Nov 2022

Technical coordinator

Monitored daily data loads and managed broker uploads in the TLM application. • Resolved reconciliation breaks and ensured data accuracy and integrity. • Served as SME and Quality Auditor, providing SQL-based data validation and issue resolution.

• Managed client onboarding and developed SQL scripts for data integration and validation. • Performed data mapping, transformation, and migration activities. • Delivered GPO migration projects for CIBC and TD clients with minimal operational impact. • Led migration calls with stakeholders and resolved data-related issues.

Conducted root cause analysis and implemented data quality improvements. • Monitored data quality and performed validation checks on transactional data. • Collaborated with Operations, Technology, and Client teams to resolve production issues. • Used SQL for data extraction, analysis, validation, and reconciliation. • • Maintained reports and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements. Supported release and migration activities through data load validation.

State Street

Nov 2020-May2022

Specialist

Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives to ensure compliant and reliable data assets. • Led Data Attestation activities and resolved missing or incorrect data flows. • Performed data profiling and DQ assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs). • Maintained metadata repositories and supported data harmonization initiatives. • Analyzed QA Break and Non-ADS reports and tracked issues using JIRA. • Onboarded new CDEs and maintained end-to-end data lineage across systems. • Created JIRA workflows and supported Agile processes, including Sprint Planning and Backlog Jan 2018-Oct 2020

Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives to ensure compliant and reliable data assets. • Led Data Attestation activities and resolved missing or incorrect data flows. • Performed data profiling and DQ assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs). • Maintained metadata repositories and supported data harmonization initiatives. • Analyzed QA Break and Non-ADS reports and tracked issues using JIRA. • Onboarded new CDEs and maintained end-to-end data lineage across systems. • Created JIRA workflows and supported Agile processes, including Sprint Planning and Backlog Management

BNY Mellon

Managed monthly and quarterly NAV calculations for hedge fund portfolios. • Prepared investor allocations, capital calls, and distributions in compliance with fund agreements. • Priced complex securities, including derivatives, private investments, and structured products, ensuring GAAP & IFRS compliance.

Performed and reconciled trading and non-trading accruals, including interest, dividends, P&L, management fees, and fund expenses, ensuring accurate financial reporting.

Managed subscription and redemption bookings, ensuring accurate investor allocations, capital flows, and compliance with fund terms.

Prepared the final NAV pack, performed billing activities, and calculated quarterly management fees.

Data Governance: Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Business Glossary, Data Catalog, Critical Data Elements (CDE), Data Profiling, Data Quality Tools: Collibra, JIRA, SQL, Power BI, Advance Excel, TLM, GENEVA, Bloomberg
• Methodologies: Agile (Sprint Planning, Scrum, Issue Tracking)
State Street
Jan 2023-Sep2025
Emerging Lead
Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives using Collibra Data Governance, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance of critical data assets across the enterprise domain and community structures.
Led the Data Attestation process by coordinating with Application Owners to validate inflows, outflows, Non-ADS gaps, and control mechanisms, and drove remediation of incorrect or missing data flows through Collibra workflows, glossary management, domain alignment, community collaboration, and metadata governance.
Performed data profiling, root cause analysis, and Data Quality (DQ) assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs) using SQL queries to identify data anomalies and ensure data integrity.
Collaborated with application teams to request and implement metadata changes in Collibra and internal systems, maintaining accurate and up-to-date metadata repositories, business glossary terms, domain ownership, community participation, and asset relationships.
Drove Data Harmonization initiatives to align data elements, data flows, and application architecture with product standards, enterprise data governance policies, domain definitions, and community best practices.
Analyzed and published QA Breaks and Non-ADS reports using SQL, created and tracked JIRA tickets, and coordinated with stakeholders to remediate identified issues across domains and communities.
Onboarded new Critical Data Elements (CDEs) into the application architecture and established lineage relationships using Collibra asset functions, including asset creation, classification, domain assignment, community mapping, and relationship management.
Configured and managed Collibra workflows, customized data capture templates, and leveraged JIRA while following Agile methodologies, including Sprint Planning, Product Backlog Grooming, and Sprint Backlog Management.
Analyzed business requirements and translated them into high-level and low-level use cases, activity diagrams, and functional specifications to support data governance, metadata management, domain modeling, and community engagement initiatives.
Utilized SQL for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities to support data quality assessments and lineage verification.
Worked closely with Data Stewards, Application Owners, and cross-functional teams to enhance metadata management, business glossary, data lineage, domain governance, and community collaboration capabilities using Collibra.
Northern Trust
May 2022 -Nov 2022
Technical coordinator
Monitored daily data loads and managed broker uploads in the TLM application. • Resolved reconciliation breaks and ensured data accuracy and integrity. • Served as SME and Quality Auditor, providing SQL-based data validation and issue resolution.
• Managed client onboarding and developed SQL scripts for data integration and validation. • Performed data mapping, transformation, and migration activities. • Delivered GPO migration projects for CIBC and TD clients with minimal operational impact. • Led migration calls with stakeholders and resolved data-related issues.
Conducted root cause analysis and implemented data quality improvements. • Monitored data quality and performed validation checks on transactional data. • Collaborated with Operations, Technology, and Client teams to resolve production issues. • Used SQL for data extraction, analysis, validation, and reconciliation. • • Maintained reports and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements. Supported release and migration activities through data load validation.
State Street
Nov 2020-May2022
Specialist
Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives to ensure compliant and reliable data assets. • Led Data Attestation activities and resolved missing or incorrect data flows. • Performed data profiling and DQ assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs). • Maintained metadata repositories and supported data harmonization initiatives. • Analyzed QA Break and Non-ADS reports and tracked issues using JIRA. • Onboarded new CDEs and maintained end-to-end data lineage across systems. • Created JIRA workflows and supported Agile processes, including Sprint Planning and Backlog Jan 2018-Oct 2020
Managed Data Lineage and Data Quality initiatives to ensure compliant and reliable data assets. • Led Data Attestation activities and resolved missing or incorrect data flows. • Performed data profiling and DQ assessments on Critical Data Elements (CDEs). • Maintained metadata repositories and supported data harmonization initiatives. • Analyzed QA Break and Non-ADS reports and tracked issues using JIRA. • Onboarded new CDEs and maintained end-to-end data lineage across systems. • Created JIRA workflows and supported Agile processes, including Sprint Planning and Backlog Management
BNY Mellon
Managed monthly and quarterly NAV calculations for hedge fund portfolios. • Prepared investor allocations, capital calls, and distributions in compliance with fund agreements. • Priced complex securities, including derivatives, private investments, and structured products, ensuring GAAP & IFRS compliance.
Performed and reconciled trading and non-trading accruals, including interest, dividends, P&L, management fees, and fund expenses, ensuring accurate financial reporting.
Managed subscription and redemption bookings, ensuring accurate investor allocations, capital flows, and compliance with fund terms.
Prepared the final NAV pack, performed billing activities, and calculated quarterly management fees.
Sales executive in Sharekhan Limited
04.2017-11.2017
Sales executive in Bloomsbury Solution
05.2016-12.2016
PGDM- Finance & Marketing from Indus Business Academy in 2015 • Bachelor Degree in Mathematics Honours from West Bengal University in 2012
